name: Webmin
description: http_download never passes cert-validation args (TLS a no-op, plain-HTTP fallback), BUT the pinned GPG signature is mandatory on the default channel and blocks RCE; only opt-in third-party channels are exposed. [Opus-verified]
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Webmin’s self-upgrade handler includes a signature-check path using GnuPG or package-specific verification. Whether that check is mandatory for the report’s default channel, and the complete transport and key policy, remain unresolved.
limitations: This review does not establish the verification behavior of each external APT, YUM, or other package manager implementation.
TLS behavior depends on the selected transport and deployment configuration, which are outside the cited package-updates implementation.

original_evidence.text: | Webmin | https://github.com/webmin/webmin.git | 72f1e7dc32e07c9fb0f0a2500e996e95238275de / 2026-08-21 | Y | N (admin-triggered from "Software Package Updates" module, `update.cgi`) | Y (auto-downloads and installs `.wbm` module/core updates via `install_webmin_module`) | https **(and plain-HTTP fallback if `Net::SSLeay` is unavailable)**; TLS cert validation NOT enforced on the update path | Y — the per-file signature (`<url>-sig.asc`) is fetched and, on the default official channel, verification is mandatory | sig (GPG), verified against a **pinned** fingerprint for the official channel; **but silently skipped/best-effort for third-party channels if the signature fetch itself fails** | pinned-in-binary — `jcameron-key.asc` + hardcoded fingerprint `1719 003A CE3E 5A41 E2DE 70DF D97A 3AE9 11F6 3C51` in source | webmin/update.cgi:23,63-72 (auto-download+install flow); webmin/webmin-lib.pl:48-49 (pinned key fingerprint); webmin/webmin-lib.pl (`check_update_signature`, mandatory when `$sigmode==2`); web-lib-funcs.pl:3388-3447 `http_download`→`make_http_connection` never passes `$certreqs`, so `web-lib-funcs.pl` `CTX_set_verify`/`VERIFY_PEER` (~line 9874) is only wired up `if ($certreqs && $certreqs->{capath})`, which never happens on this path — TLS validation is a no-op for every update/module download |
